{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicates based on patient_id, keeping the one with highest sample_seq
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Verify the number of unique patients
print("Unique patient count after deduplication:", trial_df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Replace sentinel value -999.0 in biomarker_baseline with NaN
trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] = trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Check that sentinel values are now NaN
print("Count of NaN in biomarker_baseline after replacement:", trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].isna().sum())

# Check for missing values after replacement
print("Missing values per column after replacement:")
print(trial_df.isnull().sum())"}
